title: Compass Fact Data
description: Schema for intermediate fact data files produced by the fact generator and consumed by the Compass publisher. Each file contains a facts array with one or more fact objects. Conforms to the Backstage Soundcheck Facts API: https://backstage.spotify.com/docs/plugins/soundcheck/api-reference/facts/submit-facts

facts.description: Array of one or more facts to be published to Compass.

data.description: Fact payload. Structure varies by fact type.

cache.description: Controls whether facts are persisted. Defaults to false if omitted, meaning facts evaluate checks but are not stored. Set to true to persist facts indefinitely.
